title: TraceQA client protocol
description: Messages between a client (an SDK in any language, the MCP server, a hosted worker) and the engine. JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line, over the engine's stdin and stdout. The same messages are used over HTTP when the engine is hosted.

features.description: Features this engine can run. Known values: extract.

maxScrollSteps.description: How many screens to scroll through before giving up on a very long page. 0 reads the page without scrolling.

settleMs.description: Extra time to wait after the page has loaded, before reading it. For pages that show a timed intro or splash screen. Default 0.

crops.description: Also save pictures: a screenshot of the page and one crop per component. Slower, because the page is then read and photographed one screen at a time. Default false.

includeHidden.description: List hidden elements too. Default true.

RunStartParams.description: The engine runs every target at every viewport.

outDir.description: Where to create the run folder. Default ./runs.

parallel.description: How many browsers to run at the same time. 1 runs them one after another. 0 or absent lets the engine choose from the machine's cores.

storageState.description: Start every browser with these cookies and stored values, for pages behind a sign-in or a first screen. Never written to the run folder.

RunStartResult.description: Returned as soon as the run is accepted. Progress and the result arrive as notifications.

RunDoneParams.description: Sent exactly once per run, after the run folder is complete.
